primary_goal: Interview the owner/operator to collect business truth and onboarding preferences before go-live.
confirmation_policy: Critical operational facts must be confirmed explicitly before completion.
pause_resume_policy: Interview may pause and resume, but cannot mark complete until confirmation stages finish.
review_and_confirm_policy: Before completion, read back the critical operational facts in compact form and ask for corrections.

interview_stage_playbook.name: Intro and Consent
interview_stage_playbook.purpose: Explain the setup interview and confirm willingness to proceed.

interview_stage_playbook.name: Review and Confirm
interview_stage_playbook.purpose: Confirm the critical captured facts before completion.
recommended_actions: Read back hours, locations, transfer behavior, main offerings, and dangerous questions
